QuestInfo.name: Emblem of Light
QuestInfo.0: Does Lolo know something about Aurora?
QuestInfo.1: Does Lolo know something about Aurora?
QuestInfo.2: Lolo's scroll must be from Aurora. It will probably be useful in reclaiming the power of Light and tracking down Aurora.

0.0: The master made me read every book in the library when I first started here.\r\n#L0##bAnd you read of Aurora?#l\n#k
0.1: Not quite. I saw the name next to a weird emblem. It was kinda warm...\r\n#L0##bIt must be the Aurora seal. Where did you see it?#l\n#k
0.2: On some dirty old scroll. To be honest, I was too afraid to even touch it back then.\r\n#L0##bShow me the scroll.#l\n#k
0.3: Shoot. Where did I find that old thing? Hold on a sec.

yes.0: It'll take me some time to track the scroll down. Maybe you could do me a favor while I look for it?

no.0: If you don't want to see it, I've got other work to do.
